notes.title: Phantom of Zana Update June 17th
notes.content:
Keyboard input remapping has now been added to the settings menu. It might still need some polish but to the best of my knowledge it works appropriately.

Take care out there! Stay hydrated!

notes.title: Build update #1
notes.content:
Fixed a small bug where the pause menu would become visible if pressing the "START" button on the map screen. It will no longer become visible and active as this was unintentional.

Thanks to everyone who downloaded and played Phantom of Zana! Any feedback is very appreciated!

Have fun out there! Stay hydrated!
-SnuggleFry

notes.title: Phantom of Zana Playtest Build Released!
notes.content:
Hey Party People! I've just released a playtest build of Phantom of Zana. This is a first time for developing and uploading a game to Steam. I am still trying to figure everything out. Any playtesting at all will help me to get a smoother official launch and help me add some final polish, and tidy things up. All that good stuff. 

There are so many small things to configure and polish, most of which I am totally unaware of until they pop up. 

I'll figure it all out eventually.
